aggressive_definition: Gleason score of 7 or higher, evaluated in a case-case comparison against Gleason score below 7.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: aggressive disease (Gleason scores of > or =7, n = 88) vs. less aggressive cases (Gleason scores of <7, n = 30)
study_design: Case-control study with a secondary case-case analysis of aggressive versus less aggressive prostate cancer cases
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Comparing 118 non-Hispanic Caucasian men mainly from southeast Texas with nonmetastatic prostate cancer with 52 healthy men from the same area, we conducted a case-control analysis
reason: The primary analysis compares prostate cancer cases with healthy controls. The aggressive analysis compares already diagnosed aggressive cases with less aggressive cases and therefore does not establish an incident aggressive endpoint in an initially cancer-free population.
